sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway but obscured by geopolitical conflict; small-cap explorers (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure from iron ore consolidation; small-cap gold and critical-mines names offer tactical upside

sectors.trend: RBA unlikely to cut rates to support property; rising bond yields pressure bank NIMs; ASIC whistleblower review at accounting firms adds governance overhang
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression risk; super sector (HUB.AX, PPT.AX) exposed to One Nation policy proposal

sectors.trend: Tanker wars not suppressing oil; Sydney CBD solar farm signals structural energy transition; EV adoption accelerating
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil resilience; renewable names (SOL.AX, LRN.AX) gain from policy tailwinds

sectors.trend: EV sales overtook petrol cars for first time; BYD confirms Australia EV tipping point; fuel cost avoidance driving demand
sectors.implications: Automotive retailers and EV infrastructure (e.g., EVOS.AX) benefit; traditional fuel retailers (WES.AX, IAG.AX) face structural headwinds

sectors.trend: Housing price falls accelerating; construction to follow lower; Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; Victoria debt concerns
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) under pressure; construction names (WBC.AX exposure, GPT.AX) face demand contraction

sectors.trend: McKesson oncology spend signals global healthcare M&A; AI disrupting labour markets (Auslan interpreters, banking); CrowdStrike warns on cybersecurity gaps
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX stable; ASX tech names benefit from AI infrastructure demand but face disruption risk

key_themes: RBA policy paralysis amid housing stress — no rescue coming
Iron ore structural shakeout beneath geopolitical noise
EV transition inflection point in Australia
Construction sector fragility (Bathla, unpaid work, tradie shortages)
Small-cap mining rotation in critical minerals and gold
Superannuation policy risk from One Nation proposal
ASIC governance scrutiny on Big Four accountants
Bull case narrative vs. bearish rate/housing backdrop

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / sustained high rates
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce REIT and construction exposure; favour dividend-paying large caps
Avoid construction-linked equities; monitor NAB.AX, ANZ.AX mortgage book quality; underweight property REITs
Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure (FMG.AX, BHP.AX); rotate to gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and critical minerals
Monitor HUB.AX, PPT.AX, QAN.AX for policy-driven volatility; maintain core super fund positions
Energy hedges via WDS.AX, WLE.AX; monitor AUD/USD for risk-off flows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASIC / governance scandal at Big Four
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor audit quality disclosures; potential spillover to listed companies relying on affected firms

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-mines small caps
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore shakeout shifts capital to gold (Aurum) and critical minerals (Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals); geopolitical risk premium supports gold

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on tanker-war resilience
opportunities.rationale: Oil prices supported by supply disruption; WDS and WLE offer defensive yield with upside
EV sales surpassed petrol cars; BYD confirms tipping point; charging infrastructure and battery supply chain benefit

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long large-cap banks on rate resilience
opportunities.rationale: Sustained high rates support NIMs; CBA and NAB best positioned; dividend yield attractive

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property REIT and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating housing falls, RBA non-intervention, Bathla collapse signal structural demand contraction
Shakeout underway; FMG and BHP iron ore revenue at risk; diversify into gold or LNG
ASX lower on rate fears; uncertainty elevated; preserve capital for entry points

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to lower over next 1–3 months. Rate fears, housing stress, and iron ore shakeout cap upside. Small-cap mining and energy provide relative outperformance. RBA inaction on property is a persistent overhang.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive. EV transition, critical minerals demand, and gold support structural themes. Housing correction may stabilise by mid-2027. 'Bull case returns' narrative suggests mean-reversion potential if rates peak. Key risk: construction contagion broadening.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement
